{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.62

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Sets the minimal [[Position#PositionASL|ASL]] height. Final height is {{hl|''flyInHeight'' [[max]] ''flyInHeightASL''}} - the higher altitude has priority.

|s1= aircraft [[flyInHeightASL]] [standardAltitude, combatAltitude, stealthAltitude]

|p1= aircraft: [[Object]] - helicopter, airplane

|p2= standardAltitude: [[Number]] - base altitude used when [[behaviour]] is neither "COMBAT" or "STEALTH"

|p3= combatAltitude: [[Number]] -  altitude used when [[behaviour]] is "COMBAT"

|p4= stealthAltitude: [[Number]] - altitude used when [[behaviour]] is "STEALTH"

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>cobraOne flyInHeightASL [200, 100, 400];</sqf>

|seealso= [[flyInHeight]]
}}
